title: Brave and the Bold #170 DC January 1981 Batman and Nemesis Jim Aparo Cover
condition_description: Bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; small stamped mark near the top of the back cover. See photos.
description:
The Brave and the Bold #170 (January 1981), DC Comics - Batman and Nemesis together in a 25-page thriller. Written by Cary Burkett, art and cover by Jim Aparo. 50 cent cover price.

Back cover: LEGO Expert Builder Series ad.

Condition: bright, glossy cover with light handling wear; a small stamped mark near the top of the back cover (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
